_comment: Set these paths after cloning — they point at YOUR local source workspace (never commit real paths). knowledgeBaseDir should point at analysis/<project>/knowledge-base per conversion-runbook.md's workspace convention, not inside the source checkout. Better still: keep a project-local copy of this file and pass it as PIPELINE_CONFIG=/path/to/pipeline-config.json, so this committed file never holds a real path at all.
_layout_comment: Where this source keeps its models, routes, schema and screens. The values below are the DEFAULTS the extractors use when `layout` is absent — the Cypress-RWA shape this pipeline was first built against. A source on the same stack with a different layout sets its own paths here instead of forking the extractors; that is the supported way to reuse this pipeline. Paths are relative to sourceDir.

_layout_keys.modelDirs: dirs whose every .ts holds interfaces/type aliases/enums (index.ts skipped)
_layout_keys.modelFiles: explicit files, for a source with one shared types module
_layout_keys.routeFilePattern: regex matched against a filename in routeDirs
_layout_keys.routeModuleStrip: removed from the basename to name the module
_layout_keys.sqlDirs: CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE migrations — the most reliable domain source; DROP TABLE is honoured, migrations apply in filename order
_layout_keys.serverFiles: files whose app.use('<prefix>', xRouter) calls give a router its mount prefix — without them a router declaring '/' extracts as a pathless endpoint
_layout_keys.apiClientFiles: typed API-client modules (api.listThings() -> fetch('/api/things')) — without them a client-based app links zero screens to endpoints
_layout_keys.skipEntityPattern: regex of type names that are payloads/utilities, not persistent entities
